title: Tunnels of Doom bounded dungeon-generator reconnaissance
summary: Append-only reconnaissance package. It records the authentic generation boundary, the neutral candidate payload, seed-controlled mutation phases, exact GPL/native writers, deterministic baseline and varied-seed experiments, and the explicit no-go for full generator reconstruction as one immediate package. No commercial bytes or derived artifacts are stored.

queries.question: What boundary, mutable representation, random source, and executing operations define the observed Tunnels of Doom dungeon-generation phase?
queries.answer: The trace-discovered outer routine at >62F4 calls >8002 at >63E3, which enters the per-floor routine at >8246. A 538-byte VRAM candidate payload at >34B8..>36D1 is reset by >8611/>863D, receives 23 seed-dependent value stores at >8553, and is then written by operations whose index advances by >0020 at >8339 and >0001 at >83D8; native >1D2A/>D802 performs every filtered VDP write. Changing only scratchpad seed >83C0 from >0000 to >1234 yields deterministic repeats but changes 220 payload bytes. Exact tile meanings and the later full stocking/content generator remain unresolved, so full generator reconstruction is not yet economical as one package.
